name: sway-dap
description: Module-system boundary for the bundled debug adapter. js-debug ships a CommonJS bundle with no package.json of its own, so without this file node walks up to Sway's root package.json, finds "type": "module", loads dapDebugServer.js as ESM and dies on its first require(). Nothing installs from here; see manifest.json and scripts/install-dap.mjs.
